usage: Used for the general idea of commerce, trade, and business activity; it is a fairly formal word.
Often appears in topics like economics, business policy, retail, and company operations.
Common in compounds such as 商業活動, 商業中心, and 商業世界; it sounds more formal than everyday business talk.
For learners, 商業 is a broad category word, so it is good when you mean the whole field rather than a single shop or deal.
